context: Request: across the M&A practice (incl. negotiations, JV formations, minority investments), how often signed deals carry a fraud carve-out from indemnification caps and baskets, and which deals. Rubric: 27 qualifying matters (1001-00003, 1001-00004, 1001-00005, 1001-00007, 1003-00003, 1003-00004, 1004-00003, 1005-00006, 1006-00006, 1006-00007, 1006-00008, 1007-00006, 1008-00008, 1009-00003, 1011-00006, 1013-00006, 1015-00004, 1017-00006, 1018-00008, 1032-00005, 1037-00006, 1038-00008, 1038-00009, 1039-00004, 1041-00003, 1042-00004, 1046-00001), rate 27 of 35 M&A matters (about 77%), plus precision (1022-00002 and 1027-00005 are outside the set).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob in parallel with a folder listing cut at 80 lines and file counts.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: A per-matter path script for deal words (244 matters), a find | grep cut at 240 lines, and a full folder list. The review flags the cap and the unfixed candidate set.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: A store-wide snippet scan times out; a second scan prints per-matter hit counts for broad terms. The review flags counts without snippets and unopened matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: snippet scan over a hand-picked list of 24 matters (about 85K characters), then a list of its file headers. The review flags the hand-picked list and names unopened surfaced matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Twelve reads of agreement openings (first 30-40 lines) from twelve candidates and a store-wide file-name find for investment documents. The review flags title-page reads and dozens of unopened matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Attempt 2: reads at later offsets of six agreements, openings and later sections of investment documents, and greps of its saved scan output for eight matters. The review flags reads that never reached the indemnity sections.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Clause-extraction scripts over a named list of about 13 agreement files. The review flags exclusions resting on shallow reads.

stages.stage: Calculate figures for the answer
stages.note: Computes 12 of 14 and 11 of 12 from hand-entered counts; a stage_start for writing is refused while this stage is open.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes 12 qualifying deals of 14 signed deals reviewed, with non-qualifiers and negotiation examples.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response and checks cited paths (a path that does not exist first); edits one citation.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: re-reads the openings of three agreements and the response; no edits.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: It narrowed to a hand-picked list of 24 matters after its searches showed all qualifying ones, so its rate rests on 14 deals; it also excluded three qualifying matters it opened and counted one outside the set.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its file-name search and hit-count scan at [11]-[21] listed every qualifying matter, but it scanned and then read only a hand-picked list of 24 matters, so about half of them were never opened.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) Review [31] named the hand-picked 24-matter list as the cause and later reviews repeated the unopened-matter flag; the agent read within its list.

other_errors.why: It opened three qualifying matters and counted them as not qualifying (no separate basket, non-qualifying signed merger, a subscription agreement) after reading cover pages and snippets (evidence seen at [34]-[85]).
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) Review [87] said the exclusions of a signed merger and the subscription documents rested on shallow reads; the agent went on to calculate.

other_errors.why: It counts a membership-interest purchase outside the qualifying set as a signed deal with the carve-out, from its opening lines and scan snippets (evidence seen at [41]-[77]).
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) Review [79] said this deal and two others were counted from snippets only; the agent kept it.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its first scan at [24]-[27] listed every qualifying matter, but the proximity scan kept only files with agreement-type names, which dropped a matter whose deal document is a contribution agreement, and that matter never came back.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) Review [35] named contribution agreements as documents the name filter would silently drop; the agent went on to reading.

other_errors.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
other_errors.why: The proximity scan at [32]-[33] listed six more qualifying matters, but the reads and the 20-path list it built here left them out, so they were never opened.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) Review [50] said the candidates came mostly from low-numbered matters with others unread; review [56] named the hand-picked path list. The agent wrote from the 20.

other_errors.why: One qualifying matter's executed merger agreement was in its 20-path extraction at [53]-[54], but the answer leaves the matter out.
other_errors.critic_note: Write and check reviews flagged the 100% rate and a possibly incomplete denominator, not this matter.

divergence: All three runs failed. Each reached nearly every qualifying matter early (file-name searches, hit-count or chunked scans) and then narrowed the set, and the more matters a run carried past the narrowing, the more criteria it passed (11, 20 and 24 of 29). T0 scanned and read a hand-picked list of 24 matters and wrote 12 deals (surfaced, not opened). T2 filtered its proximity scan by agreement-type file names, dropping a contribution-agreement deal, then read a 20-path list that left out six more (over-narrow filter, then surfaced not opened). T1 kept a 233-matter pool and lost only one matter to a file-name execution flag, but misjudged two it had seen and counted two outside the set. In every run a review named the narrowing step specifically (T0 [31], T1 [64], T2 [35] and [50]) and the agent moved on. Label notes were ignored in T2 (two stages); T0 and T1 kept the suggested labels or had none apply.
